original.target_description: Study 1, real monetary donations: 2 (identifiability) by 2 (teaching intervention) ANOVA interaction. This is the closest test of whether analytical thinking changes giving differentially to identifiable versus statistical victims; supplied locator does not uniquely distinguish this from other tests on the same page.

replication.target_description: Replication of Study 1 donation interaction, H2a: identifiability × explicit learning, excluding joint presentation conditions. Hypothetical donations in the four matched cells, full pre-exclusion sample. Exact intended test remains ambiguous because Table 8 contains several Study 1 effects.

notes: Primary-source titles and DOIs verified from downloaded full papers. Chose H2a interaction as the closest operationalization of the neutral description. The page-only original locator and replication Table 8 also contain identifiability and intervention main effects and do not uniquely identify an intended contrast; target_match remains null on both sides for this reason. Original intervention main effect F = 4.15 and replication H3a F = 0.89 are distinct tests, not merged with the selected interaction. Original reported recruitment N = 121 is not asserted as analytic n. Replication analytic n = 670 is summed from Table 5 matched cells (170 + 159 + 165 + 176), not the table-wide N = 1004. Original prints partial eta-squared .04 for interaction; replication Table 8 prints .001. Requested F statistic retained without conversion. Replication uses hypothetical rather than real donations and is described by authors as a far replication. The replication n quote joins the two nonadjacent Table 5 rows with a newline; each numeric row excerpt is verbatim.
